text:
By Tobias Linkin ,
4 hours ago AAU Junior Olympic Games Track And Field 2026 800M Results For All Age Divisions The 800m is done at the 2026 AAU Junior Olympic Games , with the finals for boys and girls ages 13-18 finally complete.
A new Junior Olympic record was set in the Women's 17-18 year old division. Vivian Salerno of Lancaster City ran a 2:06.54, setting a new 800m record at the games. Neenah Trusty came in second place just behind at 2:07.25 while her teammate Paige Evans came in third in the race.
Boys 15-16 saw Chance Anderson take a commanding lead and finish the race with a 1:51.95, beating out second place by nearly three seconds.
These are results for every 800m final at the 2026 Junior Olympic Games in Des Moines, Iowa.

How To Watch The Track And Field AAU Junior Olympics 2026 The 2026 AAU Junior Olympics are streaming live on FloTrack from August 1-8.
Subscribe to FloTrack to watch the games and to stay up to date with latest track and field broadcasts, events and news.
Where Are The Track And Field AAU Junior Olympics 2026 Taking Place? The 2026 AAU Junior Olympics are streaming live on FloTrack from Drake Stadium in Des Moines, Iowa.
The games were previously held in Des Moines in 2023. Iowa has hosted the games six times in it's history.
